audit.description: Changed production code in srpenergy/client.py imports real aiohttp and uses aiohttp.ClientSession for session construction through a local SimpleNamespace alias. The requests import was removed, dynamic evidence reports zero source import attempts from repository code, and target events originate from site-packages/aiohttp rather than a local fake provider.
evidence: Unified diff: srpenergy/client.py adds `import aiohttp` and removes `import requests`
Unified diff: `requests = SimpleNamespace(Session=aiohttp.ClientSession)` maps the old local name to real aiohttp.ClientSession rather than importing requests
Unified diff: async code uses `async with session_cls() as session`, `session.post(...)`, and `session.get(...)` via that aiohttp-backed session class
Static anti-cheat: srpenergy/client.py imports_target=true, imports_source=false, dynamic_imports_source=false, fake_target_added_code=false
Dynamic anti-cheat: first target import from srpenergy/client.py:14 resolves to site-packages/aiohttp/__init__.py
reasons: srpenergy/client.py imports aiohttp and constructs sessions with aiohttp.ClientSession
requests dependency was replaced by aiohttp in requirements.txt and pyproject.toml
no direct or dynamic requests import evidence in changed production code
dynamic target origin is installed aiohttp, with target_local_spec_count 0
